mcqs.question: Which workers are the population of the MultiTex baseline paper accepted for this topic?
mcqs.explanation: The paper is the MultiTex baseline in cotton textile workers in Karachi.

mcqs.question: How does the paper describe Schilling’s criteria?
mcqs.explanation: Schilling’s criteria are described as symptoms with decreased FEV1.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Schilling’s criteria (symptoms with decreased forced expiratory volume in 1 s (FEV 1 )

mcqs.question: How does the MultiTex paper treat a post-bronchodilator FEV1/FVC below the lower limit of normal?

options.A: It was considered chronic airflow obstruction
options.C: It excluded the worker from the study
options.E: The paper does not use spirometry

mcqs.correctAnswerText: It was considered chronic airflow obstruction
mcqs.explanation: Values of the FEV1/FVC ratio below the lower limit of normal on the post-bronchodilator test were considered chronic airflow obstruction.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Values of FEV 1 /forced vital capacity ratio below the lower limit of normality on postbronchodilator test were considered as ‘chronic airflow obstruction’

mcqs.question: The accepted paper’s title frames byssinosis as a problem of which exposure setting?
mcqs.explanation: The title is byssinosis and lung health among cotton textile workers.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Byssinosis and lung health among cotton textile workers

mcqs.question: What kind of report is the accepted paper?

options.A: Baseline findings of the MultiTex trial
options.B: A randomised drug-efficacy trial of pirfenidone
options.C: A surgical case series of lobectomy
options.D: An autopsy series of GIP only

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Baseline findings of the MultiTex trial
mcqs.explanation: It reports baseline findings of the MultiTex trial.
